page.overview:
What is Disrupter ray?

A disrupter ray was used to immobilize a droid without doing it any permanent damage. The ray could be fired from a handheld device.

In the revised rough draft of the prequel trilogy film Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace, General Tobler Ceel orders the Gungan Grand Army to use disrupter rays against the Armored Assault Tanks of the Trade Federation during the Battle of Naboo.
